Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Holley
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 133 as introduced would eliminate: (1) the requirement to publish the Administrative Code, and (2) the subscription charge for the Alabama Administrative Code and the Alabama Administrative Monthly, which would decrease receipts to the Legislative Services Agency by an estimated $4,740 annually, which would offset the estimated cost of $5,000 annually associated with printing fees.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Holley
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 02/16/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 133 as passed the Senate would eliminate: (1) the requirement to publish the Administrative Code in loose-leaf format, which would decrease the postage and printing costs of the Legislative Services Agency (LSA) by approximately $5500, and (2) the subscription charge for the Alabama Administrative Code and the Alabama Administrative Monthly, which would decrease receipts to LSA by an estimated $4,740 annually.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
